payload.subject: debug.root-cause
payload.decision: Treat the CredentialManager module incompatibility plus missing post-write verification as the root cause for mcp-cred.ps1 falsely reporting successful token storage.
payload.rationale: The execution path mcp-cred.ps1 set -> Set-McpToken -> New-StoredCredential fails with System.Web.Security.Membership on this Windows host; cmdkey and status confirm no credential is written, while mcp-cred.ps1 still prints OK after Set-McpToken.
